title: LocalCYOA Game File
description: Data detailing a Choose Your Own Adventure (CYOA) game.

choice.description: A choice that the player can choose to progress the story.

content.description: The name of the choice to show to the user.

next.description: The name of the next node to use if this choice is selected.

requirements.description: A list of conditions the player must fulfill to be able to select this choice.

hidden.description: Whether the choice is hidden unless the requirements are fulfilled.

actions.description: A list of actions to perform when the choice is chosen.

choiceAction.description: An action to update the game save state.

type.description: The type of action to perform.

item.description: The name of the item to add.

amount.description: The amount added to the players inventory. This number can be negative to remove items instead.

condition.description: A condition that can either be true or false.

item.description: The name of the item to check.

min.description: The minimum amount of item needed, inclusive.

max.description: The maximum amount of item needed, inclusive.

metadata.description: The metadata of the game data file.

title.description: The title of the CYOA game.

author.description: The author of the CYOA game.

version.description: The format version of the game data file.

additionalProperties.description: A story node, containing text to show to the player and a list of choices.

content.description: The main body of text to show to the player.

choices.description: A list of possible choices the player can choose.
